_**Agent (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 2026-05-12 09:25:23Z)**_

Your local `main` is behind the remote. The remote has commits you don't have locally.

**Fix:** Pull first, then push:

```bash
git pull origin main
git push origin main
```

This integrates the remote changes into your local branch before pushing. If there are merge conflicts, resolve them, then push.

**Alternative** (only if you're certain the remote commits should be discarded): `git push --force-with-lease origin main` — but this rewrites history. Use only if you're sure.
